body:
It was early summer in Michigan, I had bought some Herbal weight loss pills containing Guarana. I took two pills which was twice the suggested dose. In the first place I'm ADHD and Bipolar and people warned me about my co interactions with lithium and Risperdal but who gives.
So I took them while I was shooting a home movie. 8 minutes after I took them I started sweating and my blood pressure rose. By ten minutes I was high I was sped up and feeling good. 13 minutes later a friend asked me if I was high. I wanted to answer him but couldn't stop laughing that was the peak by that time I had made a fool of myself on camera. 16 minutes I was coming back down I had the song Never Gonna Come back Down playing in my head in hopes to not come down I did. I took Guarana again never felt the same damn it.
